recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native mobile portrait interactive novel titled “Rite Night: Possession Committee.” Preserve a five-turn, three-choice-per-turn scoring loop with three affinity lanes, immediate HUD updates, low-score fail threshold, ten possible endings, and start/restart buttons. Reinterpret the loop as a satirical possession-horror exorcism in a claustrophobic bedroom: Faith, Doubt, and Evil are the three score lanes. Use procedural canvas art for a breathing room, sacred sigil, floating vessel icon, red/gold/green particles, and a strong vignette. Use Creepster, Cinzel, and Rajdhani from approved Google font catalog URLs. Use approved eerie/dark/mysterious/heroic/sad catalog audio with user-gesture unlocking and silent failure. Prioritize readable touch-friendly buttons and portrait aspect ratios from 4:7 to 9:16.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: Interactive novel / story choice game with animated canvas backdrop.
- objective: Read each prompt, choose one of three responses, accumulate one of three affinity scores, and reach one of ten endings.
- input model: Native click/tap buttons for start, choices, and restart.
- core loop: start screen -> five dialogue turns -> score update after each choice -> ending calculation -> restart.
- fail/friction state: Low maximum affinity produces a rejection/fail ending; negative or weak choices reduce outcome quality.

## Protected Mechanics
- Five sequential choice turns with three choices per turn.
- Three tracked affinity counters and immediate HUD updates.
- Scores are added exactly by selected choice values, including negative values.
- Highest affinity wins unless all affinity totals remain below the low-score threshold.
- Ten ending slots remain mapped across fail, high/medium/low Faith, high/medium/low Doubt, and high/medium/low Evil.
- Start and restart are button-driven and mobile-tappable.

## Remix Blueprint
The old Overlord interview is regenerated as a satirical possession-horror rite. The same choice/affinity/endings structure becomes a faith-versus-evil ritual board: Faith, Doubt, and Evil replace Val, Vox, and Al while preserving scoring semantics. The visual field is rebuilt as a claustrophobic bedroom/exorcism chamber with procedural sigils, breathing walls, floating vessel iconography, sacred gold, rot green, and blood-red dread.
